jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Equipment Engineering and Integration
jobs.description:
15000 Valmont Plaza Omaha Nebraska 68154

Why Valmont

We’re Here to Move the World Forward.

Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.

Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today. We are the modern workforce . Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.

A Brief Summary Of This Position

The Technical Project Manager leads custom manufacturing equipment projects from the initial plant need through requirements, design, procurement, fabrication, integration, installation, commissioning, production validation, and plant handoff. This role combines disciplined project management with sufficient technical understanding to coordinate mechanical, electrical, controls, software, safety, process, supplier, and plant activities as one integrated system. The Technical Project Manager does not replace discipline experts; the role ensures their work is clearly defined, connected, sequenced, tested, and delivered against the plant's operating requirements. Success is measured by safe, reliable, maintainable production performance as well as scope, schedule, and cost performance.

Essential Functions

Project Definition & Planning
Translate plant operating needs into clear project requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
Establish project scope with leadership, manufacturing engineering, operations, maintenance, safety, quality, and Technology functions.
Confirm technical assumptions, interfaces, constraints, and responsibilities before design and procurement commitments are made.
Develop integrated schedules covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, controls development, testing, installation, commissioning, training, and production ramp-up.
Identify scope gaps, technical risks, and long-lead constraints early enough to prevent downstream cost and schedule impacts.
Support capital requests, cost estimates, business cases, resource plans, and project execution plans.

Technical Integration

Serve as the central integration point across mechanical design, electrical design, controls, software, fabrication, tooling, utilities, safety systems, and manufacturing processes.
Facilitate design reviews and ensure technical decisions, open items, and interface requirements are documented and resolved.
Challenge specifications and assumptions that create risk to safety, performance, reliability, maintainability, cost, or schedule.
Coordinate technical dependencies among internal GEMS team, AMET, Controls Engineering, Welding and Cutting Management, Asset Care and Reliability, plant resources, and external suppliers
Ensure changes within one technical discipline are evaluated for their effects on the complete equipment system.
Maintain decision, risk, issue, action, and change-control records throughout the project lifecycle.
Drive timely resolution of technical issues and design decisions to maintain project schedule while appropriately balancing safety, performance, cost, manufacturability, and risk.

Equipment Build & Supplier Management

Coordinate equipment design, fabrication, assembly, integration, and internal testing.
Manage technical communication and deliverables with equipment suppliers, integrators, contractors, and component manufacturers.
Confirm critical technical decisions and long-lead components are addressed early in the project.
Monitor supplier progress against technical requirements, milestones, cost, quality, and documentation expectations.
Regularly review equipment build status on the fabrication/assembly floor and identify technical, material, resource, or schedule constraints requiring resolution.
Coordinate resolution of nonconforming components, design deviations, and supplier performance issues.
Ensure purchased equipment can be integrated into Valmont's safety, controls, maintenance, operating, and data environments.

Testing, Installation & Validation

Develop commissioning and validation plans with technical leads and the receiving plant.
Establish measurable factory acceptance test and site acceptance test criteria before testing begins.
Ensure testing verifies production capability rather than only basic machine movement or functionality.
Coordinate installation, utilities, controls integration, safety validation, debugging, production trials, and ramp-up activities.
Confirm the equipment achieves agreed requirements for safety, throughput, quality, uptime, cycle time, and process capability.
Maintain an open-items process through final resolution and formal acceptance.

Plant Readiness And Handoffs

Engage plant operations, maintenance, engineering, safety, and quality personnel throughout the project.
Ensure the plant receives required training, spare-parts recommendations, preventive-maintenance plans, technical documentation, software backups, and troubleshooting knowledge.
Define ownership and escalation paths for issues that arise during installation and production ramp-up.
Coordinate the transition from project execution to sustained plant ownership and support.
Confirm performance is stable and acceptance criteria are met before project closure.
Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future equipment designs, standards, and project practices.

Project Controls & Communication

Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, actions, and changes.
Provide concise, fact-based project reporting to plant and Manufacturing Technology leadership.
Escalate decisions and constraints early with clearly defined options and recommendations.
Facilitate cross-functional meetings that produce decisions, accountable owners, and due dates.
Maintain alignment between technical progress, capital commitments, and the project's business objectives.

Other Important Details About The Role

Remain apprised of emerging equipment, automation, controls, and manufacturing technologies through supplier engagement, industry events, professional networks, and technical research.
Partner with manufacturing plants in developing site technology roadmaps that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity.
Support equipment, supplier, component, and technology standardization across the organization where standardization improves lifecycle value.
Balance near-term project delivery with equipment maintainability, reliability, obsolescence risk, and total cost of ownership.
Meet or exceed established project performance and equipment acceptance goals.
Work independently and lead through influence across functions, plants, suppliers, and contractors.
Travel up to 50%, including overnight domestic travel and occasional international travel, with periods of concentrated travel during build, installation, and startup.

Required Qualifications of Every Candidate (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities)

Bachelor's degree in engineering, engineering technology, manufacturing, industrial technology, project management, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
Five or more years of experience managing industrial equipment, automation, manufacturing engineering, or capital projects.
Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams through design, build, installation, commissioning, and production ramp-up.
Working knowledge of industrial equipment design, fabrication, electrical systems, controls, automation, machine safety, and manufacturing processes.
Experience developing project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, risk plans, and objective acceptance criteria.
Experience working directly with manufacturing plants, equipment suppliers, system integrators, contractors, and component manufacturers.
Ability to interpret technical drawings, equipment specifications, process requirements, and project documentation.
Ability to understand technical problems sufficiently facilitate decisions and recognize when escalation or additional engineering analysis is required.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, decision-making, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to lead high-visibility, high-capital projects without direct authority over all project resources.
Ability and willingness to travel to Valmont facilities and supplier locations as required.

Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Possess

Engineering degree in mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, industrial, automation, or a related field.
Project Management Professional certification or comparable formal project-management training.
Experience with custom or internally built manufacturing equipment from concept through completion.
Familiarity with PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, robotics, machine safety, and manufacturing data systems.
Experience with welding, cutting, forming, material handling, or other heavy-manufacturing processes.
Knowledge of equipment risk assessments, design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and production validation.
Experience supporting capital appropriation, investment governance, and financial forecasting.
Familiarity with reliability, maintainability, OEE, preventive maintenance, and continuous-improvement principles.

Working Environment And Physical Efforts

A normal office or remote-work environment makes up approximately 50% of the role, with approximately 50% of the work performed in manufacturing, fabrication, storage, shipping, supplier, or equipment-installation areas. In production areas, the employee may be exposed to welding smoke, noise, seasonal temperature changes, dirt, oil, coolant, moving equipment, and other conditions common to heavy manufacturing. Extended or off-shift hours may be required during equipment builds, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and critical project milestones. Travel may reach 50% and will be primarily domestic, with occasional international travel. Most tasks are sedentary or light in physical effort, but the employee may be required to stand or walk for extended periods, climb stairs, reach above shoulder height, work around machinery, and occasionally perform basic mechanical or electrical support activities. The employee may rarely lift or move up to 50 pounds; lifting devices and material-handling equipment are available for heavier items. Specific vision abilities important to this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color identification, and depth perception.

Benefits

Valmont offers employees and their families a comprehensive Total Wellbeing benefit package to ensure their individual and family’s overall wellness needs are met. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location and can include the following:

Healthcare (medical, prescription drugs, dental and vision)
401k retirement plan with company match
Paid time off
Employer paid life insurance
Employer paid short-term and long-term disability including maternity leave
Work Life Support
Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 per year
Voluntary programs like tobacco cessation, Type 2 diabetes reversal, one-on-one health coaching, mortgage services and more

Valmont does not discriminate against any employee or applicant in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabiliti

jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Oracle’s cloud infrastructure organization at the forefront of global cloud expansion. As a Program Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of complex cloud build programs in highly regulated, security-sensitive, and isolated environments. This role is responsible for coordinating large, cross-functional initiatives across planning, design, construction, deployment, validation, security hardening, accreditation readiness, and operational handoff.

You will operate in environments where standard delivery processes mustbe combined with careful issue resolution, customer-specific requirements, and the development of repeatable delivery methods for future programs. The role includes close coordination across engineering, operations, security, compliance, supply chain, networking, service readiness, facilities, and customer stakeholders to bring new cloud environments online safely, efficiently, and at scale.

Qualifications

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Program Leadership: Proven ability to develop, drive, and execute complex, large-scale infrastructure or operational programs aligned to business objectives. Experienced in translating strategic goals into actionable plans with clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, and delivery criteria.
Operational Delivery in Regulated Environments: Demonstrated experience managing programs with elevated security, compliance, or customer-specific constraints. Able to balance standardization with exception handling and convert one-time challenges into durable process improvements.
Infrastructure and Build Readiness: Experience coordinating data center, hardware, networking, supply chain, logistics, and site readiness activities. Comfortable managing ordering dependencies, design approvals, lead times, facility readiness, and vendor coordination.
Technical Acumen: Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, service dependencies, deployment workflows, operational support models, and secure environment constraints. Experience managing programs in cloud services or related technical domains is strongly preferred.
Analytical and Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills with experience tracking milestones, readiness signals, capacity assumptions, operational constraints, and program performance to guide decision-making and continuous improvement.
Collaboration and Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to align engineering, operations, supply chain, compliance, security, and business stakeholders around shared plans and decisions.
Execution Under Ambiguity: Strong problem-solving skills in environments where processes, policies, or technical approaches may still be maturing. Comfortable identifying gaps, driving decisions, and formalizing new workflows as programs evolve.

Responsibilities

End-to-End Program Delivery: Lead the program management of complex cloud expansion initiatives across the full lifecycle, from early planning and design through construction, deployment, validation, security hardening, accreditation readiness, and operational handoff. Manage stage-gate readiness, key dependencies, and execution risk throughout.
Planning and Design Coordination: Drive workstreams for site planning, operations readiness, migration planning, service readiness, and facility design. Ensure requirements are translated into executable plans, approved baselines, and clear decision records.
Procurement and Ordering Management: Coordinate standard ordering procedures across materials planning, design approvals, vendor alignment, lead-time tracking, logistics planning, and delivery readiness. Partner with engineering, supply chain, and build teams to ensure infrastructure and hardware arrive on time and in the required configuration.
Deployment and Readiness Management: Orchestrate prerequisites for deployment, including access planning, service dependencies, environment readiness, validation sequencing, and operational control points. Work across technical and operational teams to prepare secure environments for launch and steady-state operations.
Security and Compliance Integration: Coordinate security- and compliance-driven workstreams such as restricted-access operating models, environment hardening, secure transfer processes, artifact handling, support model readiness, and customer accreditation dependencies. Ensure delivery plans remain supportable within contractual and regulatory boundaries.
Cross-Functional Issue Resolution: Identify risks, blockers, and one-off issues early, then drive structured resolution across teams. Convert lessons learned into reusable standards, templates, and knowledge resources that improve future delivery programs.
Operational Transition Planning: Ensure each environment is ready for steady-state operations by coordinating support ownership, monitoring expectations, runbooks, staffing dependencies, and handoffs across technical, operational, and customer teams.
Stakeholder and Customer Engagement: Serve as a central program lead across internal leadership, engineering, operations, external vendors, and customer stakeholders. Maintain alignment on scope, schedule, risks, assumptions, and decision timelines throughout the program lifecycle.
Continuous Improvement: Help mature delivery playbooks for secure and highly regulated cloud environments by identifying recurring patterns, improving governance, and defining standard work for future builds.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Fire Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Johnson Controls, we support smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings across a wide range of industries. In this role, you will help deliver fire division projects that keep fire alarm, security, and communications systems moving smoothly from planning through closeout.

Role Overview

As a Fire Project Manager 1, you will lead complex installation projects in commercial, educational, healthcare, industrial, and military facilities. You will be responsible for setting up local project offices, defining scope and risk, coordinating resources, and managing schedule, cost, safety, quality, and customer expectations to deliver projects on time and within scope.

Key Responsibilities

Lead fire alarm, security, and communications installation projects from kickoff through closeout.
Set up local project offices and define scope, risk, project methodology, and resource allocation.
Coordinate project progression through design, permits, material delivery, labor scheduling, and field installation.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans to support schedule and budget commitments.
Conduct Work in Progress meetings and provide clear project updates to management and customers.
Manage schedule, cost, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
Ensure projects are closed on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations.
Follow published codes, standards, unique project specifications, AHJ requirements, and departmental/SOX procedures.
Coordinate change orders and support margin improvement on every job.

How You Will Do It

Stay close to the work by keeping design, permitting, materials, labor, and field installation aligned from start to finish.
Own outcomes with accountability by managing safety, quality, schedule, cost, and closeout with clear follow-through.
Use Work in Progress meetings and project reviews to surface issues early, communicate candidly, and remove obstacles before they affect delivery.
Collaborate with customers, field teams, and internal partners as one team so priorities stay aligned and decisions move the job forward.
Look for continuous improvement on every project by tightening processes, capturing lessons learned, and improving margin where possible.

Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent.
Certificate or diploma in Fire & Life Safety, Electrical/Electronic, Security, or a related field.
5 years of installation experience in fire, electrical, or security systems.
Ability to obtain Project Management Professional certification within two years of employment.
NICET Level II certification to be obtained within one year of employment.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, including Excel and Project.
Ability to create Excel spreadsheets, reference data in other spreadsheets, and create macros.
Availability for frequent local travel.

Nice to Have

Certification in Fire Alarm Systems.

Why Join Us

You will join a supportive, collaborative environment with opportunities for on-the-job and cross-training. This role offers a competitive salary and bonus plan, with a posted hiring range of $75,000 to $85,000, depending on education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. Additional benefits include paid vacation, holidays, and sick time, comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) coverage available day one, and a company vehicle. Johnson Controls also supports safety through its Zero Harm policy and values a team environment where your work has a direct impact on project delivery.

If you have the experience to lead complex fire projects and want to grow with a team that values safety, quality, and customer results, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Acquisition Project Manager - Federal Acquisition Service
jobs.description:
Summary

As an Acquisition Project Manager you will lead complex, high-value Department of War or civilian agency IT and professional service acquisitions through the pre-award lifecycle, serving as the technical expert from project initiation to task order award.

Location of position:
This position is within the Federal Acquisition Service, Assisted Acquisition Services, OSO.

We are currently filling four vacancies, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Learn more about this agency

Duties

Serves as an expert Acquisition Project Manager and concurrently and independently leads at least one or multiple highly-complex, high-dollar ($250M+) acquisitions from acquisition initiation through contract or Task Order award providing technical advice to the client, contractors, and AAS regarding pre- award strategies and activities. Identifies, analyzes, strategizes, optimally schedules, and tracks acquisition milestones to ensure that the acquisition satisfies client’s mission needs.
Assesses, defines, and documents client technical and contractual requirements which can include state of the art or unprecedented needs. Conducts market research and identifies the optimal acquisition strategy to accomplish the client requirement. Incorporates acquisition best practices to satisfy client needs. Solves complex acquisition challenges that may arise during the pre-award acquisition lifecycle.
Translates client requirements and acquisition strategy into written documentation. Prepares the solicitation and related acquisition documents in accordance with the approved acquisition strategy. Uses expert acquisition and analytical knowledge, writes technical evaluation reports summarizing the Technical Evaluation Board findings.
Develops and maintains partnerships with clients, contractor support staff, and other GSA employees. Works with the Contracting Officer to solicit competition and provide fair opportunity through industry engagement activities such as Industry Day, Reading Rooms, and Due Diligence.
Provides leadership to matrixed Integrated Project Teams during the pre-award acquisition lifecycle. Coordinates team responsibilities, manages client expectations, resolves complex acquisition issues, mentors junior staff, and ensures acquisition documentation and project files are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.

Requirements

Conditions of employment

US Citizenship or National (Residents of American Samoa and Swains Island)
Meet all eligibility criteria within 30 days of the closing date
Meet time-in-grade within 30 days of the closing date, if applicable
Register with Selective Service if you are a male born after 12/31/1959
Requires temporary duty business travel approximately 25% of the time.

If selected, you must meet the following conditions:

Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service.
Serve a one year probationary period, if required.
Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 2 investigation level).
Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security’s e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment.
Complete a financial disclosure report to verify that no conflict, or an appearance of conflict, exists between your financial interest and this position.

Qualifications

To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below.
Your resume must not exceed two pages. To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information:

Name, address, telephone number, email address;
Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade);
Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.
Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.

Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume.

The GS-13
salary range starts at $106,437per year. If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected.

To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or higher in the Federal service. Specialized experience is defined as demonstrated expertise in Federal acquisition and project management, specifically from acquisition initiation through contract or Task Order award. Such experience must include:

Providing technical advice; identifying and developing customer agency requirements;
Preparing and documenting the acquisition strategy;
Preparing statements of work and/or performance work statements;
Determining contract type; and
Leading the technical evaluation of proposals.

Additional information

Candidates will not be hired based on their race, sex, color, religion, or national origin.

Applicants are encouraged to make their resume searchable in their USAJOBS.gov profile. This will allow Federal hiring specialists and hiring managers across agencies to find their resume as part of agency recruitment campaigns or staffing searches.

If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, contact the agency or visit GSA's webpage.

Additional vacancies may be filled through this announcement in this or other GSA organizations within the same commuting area as needed; through other means; or not at all.

Relocation-related expenses are not approved and will be your responsibility.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits

A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

You will have access to many benefits including:

Health insurance (choose from a wide range of plans)
Life insurance coverage with several options
Sick leave and vacation time, including 11 paid holidays per year
Thrift Savings Plan (similar to a 401(k) plan)
Transit and child care subsidies
Flexible spending accounts
Long-term care insurance
Training and development

Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

jobs.title: Strategy & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

As a member of our Strategy & Business Operations team, you will lead planning and delivery of high priority projects. Projects include accelerating new offerings, identifying and fostering new partnerships, streamlining our operating rhythm, and fostering cross-functional collaboration. The team partners with business and product leaders to drive B-Stock’s strategy, identify opportunities for growth and investment, and drive innovation and best-in-class execution across teams. You'll also raise how the team works by applying AI to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis, building toward more automated approaches to recurring strategy and operations work over time. This person would report directly to the Vice President of Strategy & Business Operations.

B-Stock is an office-first company. You will be expected to work on-site three days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday at one of our office in Boston, MA, with Monday and Friday remaining non-office days where you may perform your duties remotely from your residence. We believe having consistent time together helps teams stay connected to the work happening across the business, collaborate in real time, and move ideas and decisions forward more effectively.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Drive end-to-end strategic projects to define and accelerate the company’s top growth priorities
Lead B-Stock’s foray into new segments, offerings, or partnerships leveraging the depth of B-Stock’s data, customer relationships, and network
Develop strategic frameworks to identify market growth opportunities for B-Stock
Help business leaders and executives make smart decisions and drive them to implementation by bringing data, analysis, and industry expertise to bear.
Identify and implement AI-enabled workflows and automations within Strategy & Business Operations to compress analysis cycles and scale the team's output
Design and run the operating cadence — planning cycles, business reviews, and cross-functional execution — turning strategy into delivered outcomes, not just recommendations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

5+ years in a strategy, consulting, finance, or business-operations role where you personally drove problems from hypothesis to delivered result
You're highly analytical and quantitatively fluent — you bring rigor to decisions and structure ambiguous problems, model in spreadsheets, pressure-test assumptions, and quantify the size of the prize.
You have a bias to impact — you've owned initiatives from strategy through execution and can point to outcomes you shipped
You communicate with clarity and influence — distilling complex analysis into simple, actionable recommendations that help executives make fast, confident decisions
Hands-on experience applying AI tools within analytical or operating workflows to build automations or multi-step processes, and comfort quickly adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge
You have a learning mindset and adapt quickly - we learn new things every day

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Two-sided marketplace, Retail, Logistics and/or Supply Chain experience
Interest in or exposure to reverse logistics, returns, or the circular economy
Experience taking a new product, segment, or initiative from 0-to-1
MBA or advanced degree from a top program, or equivalent experience

The pay rate for this role will range between $110,000 to $150,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options
Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)
Support for continuing education
Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple
Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/

OUR VALUES

Make Each Dollar Count

Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us.

Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves

Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves).

Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow

We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals.

Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success

The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed.

Find Strength In Numbers

Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers.

No applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” B-Stock also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at B-Stock.

jobs.description:
Date Posted:

2026-10-27

Country:

United States of America

Location:

US-AZ-TUCSON-928 ~ 1151 E Hermans Rd ~ MULTI PURPOSE FAC 928

Position Role Type:

Onsite

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Security Clearance Type:

Top Secret - Current

Security Clearance Status:

Active and existing security clearance required on day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon is looking for a Program Operations Manager to join the Advanced Technology (AT) Alternate Missions & Space (AM&S) team for a competitive program moving from development to Low Rate Initial Production (LRIP) in the near future.

This position requires a highly skilled and competent operations leader with an understanding of program execution and leadership skills to engage across all functional organizations. This role will serve the primary interface between the Raytheon Program Office, Raytheon factories, and Customers responsible for communicating all Program manufacturing requirements and owning cost and schedule execution. Results will be accomplished through leading, influencing, and frequent briefing across all levels of the organization including internal leaders and external customers.

This role will lead the Manufacturing Operations organization which might include Manufacturing Design Engineers for Assembly and Test, Supplier Engineers, Tooling and Packaging Engineers, Industrial Engineers, and Production Control. This role also owns cost and schedule responsibility for all Operations Non-recurring (NRE) activities associated with manufacturing activities during the development phase. In addition, this role will directly interface with the Supply Chain Lead and partners closely with Test Equipment Engineering along with Quality and Contracts leadership to ensure compliant deliverables that meet all Customer contract and mission requirements.

The ideal candidate will possess demonstrated skills across the program lifecycle including proposals, engineering and manufacturing development, and initial production along with planning for future sustainment activities. This position supports a product development effort that requires the ability to operate in a challenging and constantly changing environment. In this role you will be taking a proactive stance in ensuring our products are designed for manufacturing producibility by collaborating with Design Engineering and your technical expertise will help influence the product life cycle from development to production.

This job requires full-time onsite closed area support in Tucson with occasional travel to remote factory and supplier sites.

What You Wil Do:

Lead, collaborate, and influence quality and performance of Manufacturing Operations program deliverables, accountable for factory startup execution including manufacturing facilities, tooling, assembly & test planning, and factory test equipment
Communicate across programs sharing same-factory resources to identify, assess, collaborate, and resolve schedule and/or cost conflicts
Define clear operational schedules, priorities, and goals for each factory and key suppliers via Supply Chain partners
Serve as the Manufacturing Operations lead for proposal development, ensuring costs and schedule challenges are understood by Operations leadership, Program leadership, and Customers
Own the Operations Estimate at Completion (EAC) and budget scope, including execution of full contractual Earned Value Management (EVM) processes
Prepare and present information for Gate reviews, Weekly and/or Monthly Management Reviews, summarizing program status and any ongoing manufacturing issues
Support Operations Security (OPSEC) plan(s) execution and influence future security strategies
Participate in strategic Program/Operations planning for current development and future production efforts
Partner with Program Managers in strategic contract shaping and execution
Develop, scope, and budget for Raytheon's New Product Introduction (NPI) framework alongside Engineering and Supply Chain
Ability to travel: 5%

Qualifications You Must Have:

Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years experience
Earned Value Management System experience with Cost Account Manager (CAM) experience
Experience working in manufacturing production, including factory startup planning, tooling, and test equipment development
Experience with Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems, such as Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing (SAP) or PRISM
Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.
U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer:

Ability to work on programs requiring special program access
Experience with manufacturing development processes, including New Product Introduction (NPI) and Transition to Production (TTP)
Earned Value Management System certified with Cost Account Manager (CAM) experience
Experience supporting Proposals, Estimating, and Basis of Estimates (BOE)
Experience with lean manufacturing and factory automation
Experience with Capital Planning
Experience with Risk and Opportunity Management
Experience with Make/Buy/Where process and collaboration with Supply Chain to ensure timely hardware availability ahead of need

What We Offer

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

Learn More & Apply Now!

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role:

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Not Relocation Eligible – Relocation assistance not available.

This position requires a security clearance. DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS)
, an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Business Requirements & Process Alignment

Readiness Planning & Implementation Coordination

Risk & Issue Management

Escalate critical issues and decisions to leadership and programme governance
Track mitigation plans and ensure accountability for resolution

At least one full SAP rollout, from design to hypercare, as LIM, key user lead or functional consultant

Strong understanding of business operations, process improvement, and change management

jobs.title: Stratège, Produits IA | AI Product Strategist
jobs.description:
Stratège, Produits IA

Parce que travailler chez Cossette, c'est se brancher sur une énergie créative incomparable. C'est collaborer avec des client·e·s qui flashent sur des projets stimulants qui mettent nos forces en lumière et qui rayonnent mondialement. C'est être entouré·e de gens intelligents et allumés qui ont le feu sacré bien vivant. C'est donner un élan à sa croissance, et sentir qu'on te fait vraiment confiance. Bref, travailler chez Cossette, c'est sentir qu'on passe à un autre niveau.

Ce que tu feras

Nous recherchons un·e stratège en produits IA qui sait autant écouter un client que livrer un produit. Tu comprends les vrais enjeux derrière les besoins exprimés, tu les traduis en vision claire, et tu te mets les mains dans le produit pour que ça se concrétise. Tu es la courroie de transmission entre le client, les designers et les développeurs : tu gardes tout le monde aligné sur ce qui crée de la valeur, tu tranches sur les décisions produit, et tu t'assures que ce qu'on livre a un impact réel pour les utilisateurs finaux.

Le rôle inclut :

Agir comme expert produit IA côté client : animer les rencontres régulières, présenter les fonctionnalités et les évolutions, recueillir les retours et maintenir la relation de confiance tout au long du projet.
Définir et maintenir la vision produit, établir les priorités et assurer que l'équipe reste alignée sur ce qui apporte la plus grande valeur client et utilisateur.
Créer et prioriser le backlog fonctionnel, rédiger les spécifications (spec-driven development), et participer au backlog refinement avec les équipes de développement.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les développeur·euses GenAI pour questionner les fonctionnalités, évaluer la faisabilité, estimer les efforts et trancher sur les décisions techniques qui ont un impact produit.
Co-construire la direction produit avec les designers UX/UI : définir ce qui est un oui, ce qui est un non, aligner les priorités et s'assurer que ce qui est planifié est réaliste et livrable.
Piloter la démarche de recherche et de discovery : entrevues utilisateurs, analyse comparative, ateliers de co-création et design thinking, pour ancrer chaque décision dans des insights concrets.
Concevoir et animer des workshops clients et internes pour faire émerger les besoins, aligner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets.
Comprendre et cartographier la donnée disponible chez les clients, identifier comment la transformer, l'enrichir ou l'exploiter dans l'architecture du produit IA.
Identifier et prioriser les cas d'usage IA pertinents, qu'il s'agisse de produits B2C, B2B, d'outils internes ou de transformation des façons de travailler d'une organisation.
Assurer le suivi post-déploiement, mesurer la valeur livrée et proposer des optimisations continues.
Maintenir une veille active sur l'écosystème IA générative pour nourrir la vision produit et identifier de nouvelles opportunités pour les clients.

Ce que tu apportes

Un instinct de stratège terrain : tu définis les priorités, tu arbitres, et tu gardes l'équipe alignée sur ce qui compte vraiment.
Une capacité à entendre ce que le client dit, et surtout ce qu'il ne dit pas, pour en faire une direction produit claire et actionnable.
Un vrai mindset de problem solving : devant un obstacle, tu ne t'arrêtes pas, tu cherches la solution et tu fais avancer.
Une aisance en co-création et dans les méthodes de design thinking : entrevues, recherche, analyse comparative, animation de workshops.
Une capacité à travailler en temps réel avec des designers UX/UI et des développeurs, à challenger les approches, à évaluer la faisabilité et à prendre des décisions éclairées.
Une sensibilité à la donnée : tu sais identifier ce qui existe, comprendre comment la transformer et en faire un levier pour les produits que tu construis.
Une capacité à lire et comprendre l'architecture d'un système, à en identifier les forces et les limites, et à proposer des optimisations concrètes en fonction des objectifs produit.
Une compréhension solide de l'écosystème IA générative, des workflows agentiques et de leur potentiel applicatif dans des contextes clients variés.
Un esprit collaboratif et intrapreneurial : tu prends les devants, tu fédères, tu livres.
Capacité à gérer plusieurs mandats en parallèle avec des délais rapides et changeants.

Atouts :

Connaissance des pratiques agiles et des outils de gestion de backlog (Jira, Linear, Notion, etc.).
Familiarité avec les outils d'analytique et de données (GA4, Mixpanel, Looker, Segment, etc.).
Expérience avec des outils de design et de prototypage (Figma, etc.).
Expérience en transformation organisationnelle ou en réinvention de processus internes par l'IA.

Expérience :
5-7 ans en stratégie numérique, gestion de produit ou équivalent, dont au moins 2 ans dans un contexte IA.

Qu'est-ce que tu y gagnes ?

On valorise ta personnalité

Un environnement de travail innovant et entrepreneurial qui encourage l'ingéniosité et l'individualité - avec les meilleurs collègues et les meilleurs clients.
Des modèles de travail hybrides et des horaires flexibles, ainsi qu'une politique de travail de n'importe où pour les séjours de courte durée dans d'autres régions.
Vacances généreuses à partir de 3 semaines + 1 semaine supplémentaire pendant les fêtes de fin d'année.
Des espaces de travail modernes et ouverts, avec des cafés et des snacks, situés au cœur de la ville, à proximité de magasins et de restaurants et avec un accès facile aux transports en commun.
Événements sociaux pour l'équipe - fêtes de fin d'année, rencontres saisonnières, happy hours hebdomadaires, conférences inspirantes et bien plus encore!

On est soucieux de l'apprentissage et de l'amélioration de l'être humain

Sessions d'apprentissage et de développement en interne et conversations annuelles sur la carrière et la croissance
Accès à un réseau interne d'opportunités professionnelles dans toutes les agences du réseau Plus Compagnie
Comités EDI et groupes de ressources employé·es, programmes et initiatives dans l'ensemble de Plus Companie

Découvrez notre rapport EDI ici pour en savoir plus sur notre travail et notre engagement envers l'équité.

On investi dans ta santé et ton bien-être

Des avantages sociaux flexibles pour répondre à ton style de vie et aux étapes de ta vie - avec un accès à un compte personnel que tu peux utiliser pour une grande variété de dépenses, incluant l'abonnement à un centre de conditionnement physique, des soins pour les animaux, des frais d’études et bien d’autres.
Un soutien complet en matière de santé mentale, y compris l’accès à une clinique virtuelle qui t’offre des programmes guidés et personnalisés de thérapie cognitivo-comportementale ainsi que des séances de thérapie en direct, un accès à des cliniciens de la santé 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, et un éventail holistique de ressources en matière de santé et de bien-être pour vous et votre famille.
Des salles de santé et de bien-être lorsque tu as besoin d'un endroit pour te ressourcer.
Une politique de congés maladie et personnels responsable conçue afin que tu n'aies pas à t’inquiéter au moment où une obligation ou une urgence survient.
Régime complémentaire de maternité.

Les besoins linguistiques pour le poste sont évalués conjointement entre le gestionnaire et l'équipe d'acquisition de talents.

Ce que tu dois savoir

On est très reconnaissant·e·s par le nombre de personnes talentueuses qui postulent chaque jour pour travailler avec nous. Et on remercie chacun d'entre vous. On contactera directement les personnes que l’on souhaite rencontrer dans le cadre d'un entretien.

Working at Cossette means connecting to an incomparable creative energy. jobs.title: Finance Business Analyst Manager (Vietnamese candidates only)
jobs.description:
Thuộc phạm vi chức năng của Khối Tài chính, đặt trong quản lý của TPCC Tài chính quản trị Toàn hàng, có vai trò trung tâm trong hệ thống quản trị tài chính và điều hành kinh doanh của Ngân hàng.
Mô tả công việc

Xây dựng và phát triển đội ngũ, chỉ đạo và điều phối hoạt động của team nhằm phát triển và hoàn thiện hệ thống công cụ và năng lực chuyên môn về quản trị tài chính, tham vấn chuyên môn đóng góp xây dựng, cải thiện công tác tài chính quản trị toàn hàng, với các phần hành công việc cụ thể:
Điều phối và quản lý hệ thống báo cáo tài chính quản trị toàn hàng (bao gồm công ty con): Xây dựng chính sách, theo dõi và kiểm soát hệ thống báo cáo TCQT của toàn Ngân hàng các cấp độ, thực hiện cơ chế ghi nhận phù hợp định hướng kinh doanh và các chuẩn mực kế toán và Xây dựng, phát triển hệ thống báo cáo quản trị định kỳ và bất thường nhằm phục vụ việc ra quyết định điều hành của Hội đồng quản trị, Tổng Giám đốc và các cấp Lãnh đạo của Ngân hàng.
Phân tích tổng quan, đa chiều về tình hình hoạt động kinh doanh, hiệu quả kinh doanh, lợi nhuận của toàn Ngân hàng.
Thực hiện các đánh giá, phân tích cần thiết để tham vấn cho công tác điều hành của Ban lãnh đạo.
Dự báo kết quả kinh doanh của toàn hàng và phân tích các xu hướng, các nguyên nhân có ảnh hưởng tới tình hình thực hiện kế hoạch của toàn Ngân hàng.
Đánh giá và tư vấn tác động của các chính sách/tham vấn lên việc thực hiện kế hoạch kinh doanh toàn hàng, đảm bảo đạt được những mục tiêu đã đặt ra.
Chủ trì/đóng góp các dự án/kế hoạch nâng cao năng lực quản trị tài chính, bao gồm tự động hóa báo cáo, ứng dụng công cụ phân tích dữ liệu/AI.

Yêu cầu công việc

Tốt nghiệp đại học về lĩnh vực tài chính và có ít nhất 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong cùng lĩnh vực. Đã có tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm về quản lý đội nhóm và phát triển đội ngũ, có tư duy chiến lược, năng lực phân tích sâu và khả năng tạo ảnh hưởng liên đơn vị. Ưu tiên làm việc trong lĩnh vực ngân hàng về thực hiện báo cáo quản trị toàn hàng, kế hoạch ngân sách, phân tích kinh doanh, quản lý tài sản nợ - tài sản có, các hoạt động kinh doanh của ngân hàng. Cụ thể:
Chuyên môn:
Am hiểu hệ thống sản phẩm, mô hình kinh doanh và các động lực tạo lợi nhuận, cấu trúc thu nhập – chi phí, các chỉ số hiệu quả và các yếu tố ảnh hưởng đến lợi nhuận của ngân hàng; đồng thời có hiểu biết về hoạt động của các lĩnh vực tài chính liên quan trong hệ sinh thái như chứng khoán, bảo hiểm, tài chính tiêu dùng, nhằm đánh giá hiệu quả kinh doanh ở cấp độ hợp nhất toàn hàng.
Hiểu biết và có khả năng nắm bắt nhanh, cập nhật kịp thời và đánh giá thông tin yếu tố kinh tế vĩ mô và khung pháp lý liên quan đến hoạt động tài chính – ngân hàng, bao gồm quy định đối với tổ chức tín dụng, chứng khoán, bảo hiểm, cũng như các chuẩn mực VAS, IFRS, Basel … nhằm đảm bảo việc phân tích và ghi nhận tài chính phù hợp với bối cảnh thị trường và quy định
Có năng lực tổng hợp, mô hình hóa và phân tích các bộ dữ liệu tài chính – kinh doanh phức tạp ở cấp độ toàn hàng, đồng thời thiết kế phương pháp luận và kiến trúc hệ thống báo cáo tài chính quản trị nhằm chuyển hóa dữ liệu thành các insight chiến lược phục vụ điều hành.
Có tư duy và kỹ năng hệ thống hóa, tự động hóa và tối ưu vận hành để có thể thiết lập và phát triển hệ thống báo cáo đầy đủ và hiệu quả.
Chịu được áp lực công việc và có khả năng quản lý thực thi nhiều yêu cầu công việc:
Kỷ luật trong quản lý công việc, có kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề tốt
Tư duy logic tốt, chủ động trong tìm tòi, phát triển và làm mới công việc, hướng về hiệu quả
Yêu cầu khả năng trình bày tổng hợp và trao đổi mạch lạc, quyết đoán.
Tự tin trong giao tiếp và quản lý các mối quan hệ công việc, khả năng thuyết phục và gây ảnh hưởng trong đội ngũ cũng như các bên liên quan

Thưởng các Ngày lễ, Tết (theo chính sách ngân hàng từng thời kỳ)
Được vay ưu đãi theo chính sách ngân hàng từng thời kỳ
Chế độ ngày phép hấp dẫn theo cấp bậc công việc, được hưởng chế độ du lịch hè
Bảo hiểm bắt buộc theo luật lao động + Bảo hiểm VPBank care cho CBNV tùy theo cấp bậc và thời gian công tác
Được tham gia các khóa đào tạo tùy thuộc vào Khung đào tạo cho từng vị trí

Job Description:

GDIT seeks exceptionally qualified individuals to serve as a Counterintelligence (CI) Analyst to support USSOCOM. The CI Analyst provides timely, cogent, and relevant advice to improve the CI posture of supported activities, ensure intelligence oversight compliance, and accurately document and report CI indicators or concerns. Coordinate and support cross-community meetings and working groups, assimilate large volumes of information, de-conflict information of value between sections, and independently produce reports. Research, create, develop, and deliver professional multi-media and written reports; receive Contact, Lead, and Intelligence Information Reports, participate in reviews, and respond with corrective measures as necessary. Develop all-source association matrices on screened individuals of CI interest. Research, develop, and present CI products at the operational and strategic levels utilizing multiple CI and HUMINT reporting tools on SIPR and JWICS systems. Manage Source data information within the Integrated Defense Source Registration System as well as participate in Asset Validation Panels and provide accurate, in-depth CI reviews of all active assets. Maintain familiarity with signature reduction training standards and processes; assist the command in determining the appropriate use of signature reduction techniques and ensure all standards are met before signature reduction techniques are applied.

Employees must maintain global readiness and be available to deploy on a no-notice basis to hazardous duty/combat zones. Deployments may be to a theater of operations with permissive, uncertain, or hostile environments while living in austere conditions for extended periods.

Job Requirements
:

Counterintelligence Analyst shall possess the following qualifications:

Minimum six (6) years of experience as a Counterintelligence Agent of equivalent service/interagency occupational specialty focused on source operations
Graduate of Joint Counterintelligence Training Academy (JCITA) Advanced Counterintelligence Collections Course, service, or interagency equivalent
Experience conducting CI threat assessments, vulnerability assessments, and route reconnaissance
Experience collaborating with joint and federal agencies on emerging trends and threats in the area of operation
Experience with Digital Network Intelligence, Call Chain analysis, Computer Network Operations, Cyber Analysis, and SIGINT for acquiring, identifying, reporting and processing multiple mission types
Knowledge of SIGINT collection and processing, computer protocols, and communications technologies
Ability to display ingenuity, resourcefulness, and application of highly advanced technologies, scientific principles, theories, and concepts
Ability to leverage existing applications or methods and provide input into the development of new applications that improve products or methods
Possess excellent oral and written communication skills
Current Top Secret clearance and SCI eligible with a CI polygraph
Must possess a valid US passport

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Title:
Market Intelligence Analyst

Location:
633 3 rd Ave, New York, NY 10017

Reports to:
Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline

Compensation
: $78,000 - $88,000/Yr ( based on experience and qualifications )

About The Fedcap Group

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Market Intelligence Analyst is responsible for generating high-quality leads and producing the external market insight required to build tomorrow's pipeline.

The postholder will proactively identify and assess potential opportunities through commissioner and funder intelligence, policy and procurement scanning, competitor analysis and market sizing. The role will turn external signals into clear lead briefs and actionable intelligence for Growth, Opportunity Management and senior decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Early Opportunity Identification

Generate a continuous flow of credible, evidence-based leads across priority sectors, services and geographies. Identify opportunities early enough to support market shaping, relationship development and organizational readiness.

Proactively scan target markets for new contracts, funding streams, grants, frameworks and adjacent growth opportunities.
Monitor procurement portals, prior information notices, funding announcements, market engagement activity and published commissioning plans.
Create and maintain a forward-looking opportunity radar, including expected value, timing, buyer, route to market and source evidence.
Prepare initial lead briefs and assess strategic relevance, accessibility, maturity and next actions.
Route viable leads to the Director and relevant Growth leaders for screening, ownership and progression into the enterprise pipeline.
Track the conversion of intelligence-generated leads into qualified opportunities and use outcomes to improve lead-generation activity.

Commissioner & Funder Intelligence

Build a current, practical understanding of commissioners, funders and procurement bodies to strengthen lead generation and market positioning. Translate published priorities, budgets and commissioning intentions into clear implications for growth.

Research commissioner and funder strategies, priorities, budgets and future commissioning intentions.
Develop and maintain profiles of priority commissioners, funders and procurement authorities.
Track consultations, market engagement events, pipeline publications and recommissioning cycles.
Provide targeted intelligence to support Executive Directors with market-shaping and relationship activity.

Policy, Funding & Procurement Scanning

Monitor external developments that may create, accelerate or constrain future opportunities. Provide concise alerts and analysis so the organization can respond to policy change, new funding and procurement reform.

Monitor relevant policy, legislative, regulatory, economic and funding developments across priority jurisdictions.
Assess the likely impact of external changes on demand, commissioning models and market accessibility.
Maintain procurement and funding calendars for priority markets and service areas.
Issue timely alerts on material developments, approaching deadlines and emerging opportunities.
Maintain source records and evidence trails for material intelligence.

Market Assessment & Sizing

Produce evidence-based assessments of market size, attractiveness and accessibility. Support decisions on where to invest, enter, monitor or deprioritize by combining external evidence with clear analysis.

Conduct market sizing using available public, commercial and internal sources.
Assess growth drivers, customer demand, funding outlook, barriers to entry and route-to-market considerations.
Support market-entry, geography and service-line assessments.
Compare opportunities and markets using agreed attractiveness and strategic-fit criteria.
Present findings in concise market maps, briefing papers and recommendation summaries.

Competitor & Ecosystem Intelligence

Maintain a fact-based view of competitors, incumbents, partners and market movements. Identify threats, gaps and partnership possibilities that strengthen opportunity strategy and competitive positioning.

Research competitor portfolios, contract awards, partnerships, acquisitions and observable strategic activity.
Develop and maintain competitor and incumbent profiles for priority markets.
Monitor new entrants, market disruptors and relevant partner ecosystems.
Identify market gaps, likely competitive pressure and potential areas of differentiation.
Provide early competitor intelligence to Growth, Opportunity Management and the Bid & Proposal Centre of Excellence.

Intelligence Products & Knowledge Management

Convert research into accessible, decision-ready products and maintain a reliable intelligence knowledge base. Ensure outputs are current, traceable and focused on actions and implications.

Produce regular intelligence bulletins, opportunity alerts, market briefs and executive summaries.
Maintain organized repositories for markets, commissioners, funders, procurements and competitors.
Apply agreed research, sourcing, confidentiality and quality standards.
Respond to priority research requests and clearly distinguish fact, interpretation and assumption.
Contribute intelligence to win/loss reviews and continuously improve sources, tools and methods.

Requirements

Experience & Education

Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting
Experience in market research, business intelligence, commercial analysis, lead generation or business development.

Knowledge & Skills

Demonstrable ability to identify opportunities from policy, funding, procurement and market information.
Strong analytical, research and problem-solving capability, with careful source validation.
Excellent written communication and the ability to produce concise, decision-ready briefings.
Confident use of Microsoft Excel, online research sources and information-management tools.
Ability to prioritize competing research requirements and work independently to deadlines.

Why Join Fedcap

Join The Fedcap Group and experience The Power of Possible. Be part of a mission-driven organization creating opportunities for individuals facing barriers to economic well-being. Every day, we open doors to economic mobility and stronger communities through education, workforce development, health, and economic development.

Benefits

Medical, Dental & Vision | Life/AD&D & Long-Term Disability | Flexible Spending Account (FSA) | Commuter Benefits | 403(b) | Wellness Program
May vary by location and business unit.

EEO

The Fedcap Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a respectful workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, provincial, or local law.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Number, quality and progression of intelligence-generated leads.
Timeliness of lead identification relative to procurement and funding deadlines.
Accuracy, relevance and traceability of commissioner, funder, procurement and competitor intelligence.
Quality and usefulness of opportunity briefs, market assessments and intelligence products.
Coverage of agreed priority sectors, geographies and service lines.
Stakeholder confidence in the insight provided.
Conversion of identified leads into qualified pipeline opportunities.

About Us

Mission:
We are committed to improving the economic and social well-being of the impoverished and disadvantaged.

For 85 years, The Fedcap Group has developed scalable, innovative and potentially disruptive solutions to some of society’s most pressing needs. The Fedcap Group is the parent company of a growing number of top-tier nonprofit agencies dedicated to serving over 300,000 children and adults each year across the United States and the United Kingdom. jobs.description:
Position Title:

Information Security Analyst

Position Type:

Regular

Hiring Range:

$102,800 - $128,560 annually; Compensation will be based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.

Pay Frequency:

Annual

This position is required to have an on-campus presence in Santa Clara CA

POSITION PURPOSE

The Information Security Analyst is a versatile, hands-on security generalist who strengthens university-wide cybersecurity through process automation, technical risk reviews, security posture monitoring, and multi-platform incident response. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) within the Information Security Office, this role serves as an adaptable technical and operational partner across the institution.

The Security Operations Analyst reports to the Chief Information Security Officer and is a member of the Information Security Office. This office works with the university community to secure system and network resources, protect the confidentiality of student, faculty, and staff information, and improve the university’s security posture. In conjunction with technical teams, risk management, legal, and other university and external vendors and partners, the Information Security Office works to ensure regulatory compliance, best practices, and secure information handling.

The activities of this position must support the Mission and Goals of the University and Information Services. Demonstrated experience with and a commitment to delivering excellent customer service is required.

This position is not eligible for fully remote work. On-site work in Santa Clara CA on a weekly basis is required.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Campus Engagement & User Risk Advisory (30%)

Service Desk & Operational Triage: Respond to security requests assigned to the Information Security Office within defined SLAs. Handle routine exception requests and actively identify opportunities to update, streamline, and document standard operating procedures.
Behavioral Guidance: Translate technical security concepts into practical, clear, and actionable behavioral security advice tailored for non-technical stakeholders.
Risk Consultations: Meet directly with faculty and staff to conduct approachable, lightweight risk assessments of departmental workflows, software usage, and data handling practices.

Workflow Automation, Scripting, and AI (20%)

Process Automation: In collaboration with senior team members, design, write, and maintain Python, PowerShell, shell scripts, and AI tools to eliminate manual operational tasks, streamline repetitive security workflows, and improve team efficiency.
API & System Integrations: Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining RESTful API integrations and webhooks to connect security and infrastructure platforms for improved visibility and automation.

Multi-Platform Incident Response (25%)

Incident Investigation & Containment: Under the guidance of senior leadership, assist in the technical investigation and containment of information security incidents.
Cross-Platform Investigation: Utilize SIEM and automated tools as an initial baseline, applying strong analytical judgment to determine next steps when telemetry is incomplete or requires deep-dive investigation.
Triage: Review alerts and vulnerability reports to determine risk; contact system owners and track remediation.
Incident Documentation: Prepare clear incident reports detailing timeline, impact, technical findings, and post-incident remediation steps.

Systems Security Reviews (25%)

Third-Party System Implementations: Partner with IT engineers and system owners during the deployment of new third-party services to ensure baseline security controls and data protection practices are applied prior to launch.
Compliance: Evaluate technical system configurations, data flows, and infrastructure deployments for compliance against standard regulations such as FERPA, HIPAA, GLBA, PCI, and similar.
Infrastructure Posture Reviews: Perform routine security evaluations and scans across university systems and identity environments to detect hygiene issues, unneeded privileges, and configuration weaknesses, partnering with technical teams to implement remediation steps.

PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION

This position does not have any direct reports.

GENERAL GUIDELINES

Recommends initiatives and implements changes to improve quality and services.
Identifies and determines cause of problems; develops and presents recommendations for improvement of established processes and practices.
Maintains contact with customers and solicits feedback for improved services.
Maximizes productivity through use of appropriate tools; planned training and performance initiatives.
Researches and develops resources that create timely and efficient workflow.
Prepares progress reports; informs supervisor of project status; and deviation from goals.
Ensures completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all operational functions.
Prepares and submits reports as requested and required.
Develops and implements guidelines to support the functions of the unit.
Works under general supervision and in close collaboration with senior analysts, engineers, and the CISO to execute security automation, perform risk reviews, and handle incident response.
Consults with senior security leadership on complex architectural decisions, policy exceptions, or high-severity incidents.
Builds positive, collaborative relationships across academic and administrative departments, serving as an approachable technical liaison.
Prepares and submits technical metrics and routine incident reports as requested.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The items below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, education, and experience required or preferred. This position requires the ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a diverse multicultural environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

General

Knowledge of information technology, infrastructure trends, and information security concepts, with the ability to continually develop new technical knowledge and skills.
Ability to work in a collaborative environment, as either a member or leader of a project team, to meet deadlines and achieve goals.
Ability to interact with a diverse workforce to provide excellent customer service.
Demonstrates high self-motivation, a bias for action, and a passion for continuous improvement.
Ability to successfully keep track of and manage multiple tasks and project assignments simultaneously.
Ability to exercise independent judgment and engage in critical thinking and complex problem solving.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to operational security issues in a dynamic technical environment.
Ability to explain technical, risk, and automated security concepts to non-experts and diverse audiences.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and securely manage confidential information.
Must possess impeccable integrity, executing responsibilities while maintaining the trust and confidence of senior management.
Appreciation for the University’s mission, vision, values, priorities, procedures, and policies.

Position-Specific

Proficiency in Python or shell scripting (e.g., Bash) for basic data manipulation, log parsing, or automating repetitive tasks.
Hands-on experience working with RESTful APIs, webhooks, and standard data exchange formats (e.g., JSON, XML)
Familiarity with applying CIS Benchmarks or similar security baselines to evaluate system configurations.
Practical experience with PowerShell and inspecting Active Directory and Group Policy Objects
Familiarity with core security concepts (e.g., common network protocols, operating system security internals, and log analysis across Windows, Linux, and MacOS).
Basic understanding of common compliance and privacy standards relevant to a university setting (e.g., FERPA, GLBA).
Education
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution of higher education required (ideally in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline).
Security or automation-focused certifications preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISA, Security+, GSEC, or certified Python/Cloud practitioner credentials).
Experience
6+ years of related technical experience in software development, IT operations, or information security operations or similar.
Demonstrated experience building programmatic scripts, connecting via APIs, and automating technical workflows.
Experience working within a Higher Education or highly regulated data environment is preferred.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with Safety, Operations, Account Management, and other stakeholders to identify trends, monitor performance, support investigations, and improve safety outcomes. Platinum Pacific Partners has been exclusively engaged to find a Business Analyst for an established, independent Australian wealth and asset manager with listed and unlisted funds. As the business continues to grow, this role will be central to new product launches and the platforms behind them.

About the Role

Reporting to the head of the function, you’ll be the link between the business, its technology team and external platform partners. You’ll lead systems and platform change across investment operations. That covers the core operating systems, from order and portfolio management through to accounting and investor administration, along with the firm’s requirements on the adviser and wealth platforms that carry its products. Delivering the systems side of new products and initiatives will be a large part of the role. Alongside it, you’ll take ongoing ownership of the established systems, keeping them fit for purpose and delivering a pipeline of improvements. You’ll work with the operations, technology, investment, finance, legal, compliance and distribution teams, as well as external vendors and service providers, and you’ll be trusted to run work from start to finish.

Identifying, prioritising and delivering enhancements across the core investment operations systems, including upgrades and regulatory change
Defining the operational and platform requirements for product launches and fund events such as restructures, transitions and term changes
Coordinating system vendors, service providers and distribution platforms to get changes delivered
Analysing operational and platform data and working with the internal technology team on management reporting and dashboards
Running the analysis throughout, from requirements workshops and process mapping to testing, UAT, business readiness and post-implementation review
