Company Description

Project Manager, Data Center Facilities

500 Summit Lake Drive, Suite 180, Valhalla, New York, United States

Full-time

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries with thousands of experts working across 70 offices in the Americas. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.

Job Description

The Project Manager manages key client projects. Project management responsibilities include the coordination and completion of projects on time within budget and within scope. Oversee all aspects of projects. Set deadlines, assign responsibilities and monitor and summarize progress of project. Prepare reports for upper management regarding status of project.

Lead the successful execution of projects by coordinating internal teams and third-party vendors while ensuring quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

Deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget through effective planning, resource allocation, and progress monitoring.

Define project scope, objectives, and technical requirements in collaboration with clients and key stakeholders to ensure project feasibility and alignment.

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, manage scope, schedule, and cost changes, and measure project performance using appropriate tools and methodologies.

Build and maintain strong client, stakeholder, and vendor relationships while conducting risk management activities to proactively mitigate project challenges.

Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, lead client meetings, gather detailed project requirements, and ensure clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications

Proven project management experience within a consulting engineering firm, with data center design project experience preferred.

Skilled at translating client requirements into comprehensive fee proposals and project scopes.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Engineering or Architectural) or equivalent professional experience; PMP certification preferred.

8+ years of project management experience

Strong leadership capabilities, including coaching, supervision, staffing, and performance management.

Expertise in project management best practices, including budget development and tracking, planning, process improvement, and team management.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Build a career where your analysis helps expand affordable housing and strengthen communities. You will work alongside experienced commercial real estate professionals to structure financing solutions for mission-driven clients across the United States. This role offers hands-on transaction exposure, skill-building training, and opportunities to learn how banking supports community development outcomes. You will be based in our San Francisco, California office, working closely with a collaborative team

As a Community Development Banking Analyst in Community Development Banking within Commercial Real Estate, you will support financing solutions that help grow affordable housing and revitalize low- and moderate-income communities. You will partner with bankers, underwriters, and treasury services and payments colleagues to analyze transactions, prepare materials, and contribute to credit and portfolio work. You will deepen your commercial real estate and community development banking foundation through real work, coaching, and structured learning, with the potential to progress to the Associate level upon successful program completion.

Job Responsibilities

Build and update financial models, cash flow analyses, and risk grading materials to support community development financing transactions
Assist with underwriting, credit approval, annual reviews, and other credit-related deliverables
Analyze property, market, sponsor, guarantor, and transaction information, with a focus on affordable housing and community development projects
Prepare marketing and client materials covering financing alternatives, transaction considerations, and relevant industry and market trends
Summarize deal metrics, key risks, mitigants, and transaction facts for internal review and decision-making
Support bankers and underwriters with ad hoc requests, due diligence, market research, and transaction execution
Assist with portfolio monitoring and ongoing client and transaction support
Develop an understanding of treasury services solutions and the end-to-end client and transaction process
Build knowledge of the breadth of JPMorganChase products and service offerings

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Bachelor's degree with graduation in December 2024 or Spring/Summer 2025
Authorization to work in the United States in accordance with the requirements for this program
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a collaborative environment

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Internship experience or coursework in real estate, finance, accounting, economics, or a related field
Interest in affordable housing, community development finance, and commercial real estate banking
Familiarity with financial statement analysis, pro forma modeling, cash flow analysis, or credit concepts
Interest in working in the Los Angeles office to build client relationships and deliver strong client service

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase's review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
